title: Where can you fly direct from Manchester Airport?
author: Brogan
intro: Manchester has more direct routes than any UK airport outside London, from winter sun and Lapland to Dubai, Singapore and Barbados. Here's what flies direct this winter, and what's new.
seo_title: Direct flights from Manchester Airport: 2026/27 list
seo_description: Canaries, Cape Verde, Egypt, Lapland, ski and Jet2 city breaks, plus Dubai, Doha, Singapore, Orlando and Barbados. Manchester's direct routes this winter.

sections.heading: Manchester at a glance
sections.text:
Manchester is the UK's third busiest airport and the biggest outside London, with three terminals. Jet2, easyJet, Ryanair and TUI all have large bases here, so the short-haul choice is huge. On top of that, it's the one airport in the north of England with a proper long-haul network.

This list covers the main routes for winter 2026/27, checked in October 2026. Airlines add and drop routes often, and some only fly on certain days, so **check the airline's timetable before you plan around a route**.

sections.heading: Winter sun
sections.text:
The Canary Islands are the easy winter choice from Manchester. Several airlines fly to all four of the main islands, with flights of about four to four and a half hours:

- [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) and [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) for the most reliable warmth.
- [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) for volcanic scenery and smaller resorts.
- [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura) for long beaches and wind.

Further afield:

- **[Madeira](/destinations/madeira):** regular flights to Funchal, for mild, green winter breaks.
- **[Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde):** easyJet and TUI fly non-stop to Sal, and TUI also flies to Boa Vista. It's warmer than the Canaries in winter, at around six hours.
- **Egypt:** Jet2 is adding Manchester flights to **Sharm El Sheikh** and **Hurghada** for winter 2026/27. EasyJet is starting a new route to **Cairo's Sphinx airport**, the closest to the Pyramids of Giza, from 9 November, twice a week.

Our [December](/destinations/where-to-go-in-december) and [February](/destinations/where-to-go-in-february) pages compare how warm each place really is.

sections.heading: Lapland and the snow
sections.text:
Manchester has direct flights to Finnish Lapland this winter:

- **[Rovaniemi](/destinations/rovaniemi):** easyJet flies on set days from 17 November 2026 to 5 January 2027.
- **Kittilä**, for [Levi](/destinations/levi): easyJet flies seasonally.

There are also many Lapland charter packages from Manchester, including day trips. Our post on [whether a Lapland day trip is worth it](/blog/lapland-day-trip-from-the-uk) compares them.

For skiing, Jet2 and Ryanair fly to **Salzburg** from December to April, which is handy for resorts like [Zell am See](/destinations/zell-am-see). There are also flights to **Geneva** for the French and Swiss Alps. Check the days, as ski routes often only fly at weekends.

sections.heading: City breaks and Christmas markets
sections.text:
Jet2's winter 2026/27 programme from Manchester includes [Athens](/destinations/athens), [Barcelona](/destinations/barcelona), [Berlin](/destinations/berlin), [Budapest](/destinations/budapest), [Cologne](/destinations/cologne), [Rome](/destinations/rome), [Gdansk](/destinations/gdansk), [Krakow](/destinations/krakow), [Porto](/destinations/porto), [Prague](/destinations/prague), [Tallinn](/destinations/tallinn), [Venice](/destinations/venice) and [Vienna](/destinations/vienna). It's also adding [Strasbourg](/destinations/strasbourg), home to one of France's best-known Christmas markets.

Ryanair and easyJet add more city routes, including Ryanair's new flights to Warsaw Modlin this winter. If you're choosing between markets, our posts on [Vienna or Prague at Christmas](/blog/vienna-or-prague-at-christmas) and [Strasbourg or Colmar](/blog/strasbourg-or-colmar-at-christmas) might help.

sections.heading: Long-haul from Manchester
sections.text:
This is where Manchester stands out from other regional airports:

- **The Gulf:** Emirates flies to [Dubai](/destinations/dubai), and Qatar Airways flies to Doha around 13 times a week. Both connect onwards to Asia, Africa and Australia.
- **Asia:** Singapore Airlines flies non-stop to [Singapore](/destinations/singapore), which takes about 13 hours. IndiGo flies to Mumbai and Delhi.
- **The USA:** Virgin Atlantic flies to [Orlando](/destinations/orlando), Atlanta and [New York](/destinations/new-york). It's moving Orlando to its bigger A350-1000 for winter 2026, with 17% more seats.
- **The Caribbean:** Virgin Atlantic flies direct to [Barbados](/destinations/barbados) in winter.
- **Canada:** Air Canada's [Toronto](/destinations/toronto) route runs all year from October 2026.

One change to know about: Aer Lingus closed its Manchester long-haul base in March 2026, so its flights to New York, Orlando and Barbados have ended. Virgin Atlantic still covers all three.

sections.heading: Getting to Manchester Airport
sections.text:
Manchester Airport has its own railway station, with direct trains from Manchester Piccadilly and towns across the north of England. There's also a Metrolink tram stop. The M56 runs right next to the airport, but drop-off zones charge, so check current prices or pre-book parking.

The airport has three terminals, and airlines use different ones. Check yours before you set off. For early flights, our post on [how early to arrive at Manchester Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-manchester-airport) covers timings.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Manchester?
sections.text:
With this much choice, the hard part is picking one. For a first winter sun trip, [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) is the safe bet. For something warmer, try [Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde). For a short city break, it's hard to beat [Krakow](/destinations/krakow) or [Budapest](/destinations/budapest). Our [January](/destinations/where-to-go-in-january) and [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) pages have more.

If everyone wants somewhere different, our guide to [how to decide where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) shows how to settle it. Everyone adds ideas, gives them points, and a draw picks the winner.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Manchester to Lapland?
faqs.answer: Yes. For winter 2026/27, easyJet flies from Manchester to Rovaniemi on set days from 17 November to 5 January, and seasonally to Kittilä for Levi. There are also charter packages.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Manchester to Barbados?
faqs.answer: Yes, Virgin Atlantic flies direct from Manchester to Barbados in winter. Aer Lingus's Manchester flights to Barbados ended when its base closed in March 2026.

faqs.question: Does Manchester have direct flights to Egypt?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jet2 is adding Sharm El Sheikh and Hurghada for winter 2026/27, and easyJet flies to Cairo's Sphinx airport twice a week from 9 November 2026.

faqs.question: What long-haul flights go direct from Manchester?
faqs.answer: Routes include Dubai with Emirates, Doha with Qatar Airways, Singapore with Singapore Airlines, Orlando, Atlanta, New York and Barbados with Virgin Atlantic, and Toronto with Air Canada. Check current timetables, as routes change.
